candidates.title: Powerful Blast Hits J&K’s Poonch Forward Areas; Security Heightened
candidates.excerpt: The powerful blast reportedly occurred in Satwal-Naki area near the zero line, during the movement of a group of people along the Pakistan side of the LoC, officials said.

candidates.title: Rupee Gains 96 Paise Against Dollar After RBI Stabilisation Measures
candidates.excerpt: The rupee rose 96 paise to ₹95.77 per dollar after the RBI introduced measures to curb speculative trading and ease dollar demand in the foreign exchange market.

candidates.title: Tribal youth’s suspicious death triggers tension in Kothagudem
candidates.excerpt: The death of tribal youth Badavath Ravichandra in Karakagudem mandal triggered tension, with relatives accusing a Congress leader of protecting the accused. Police intervened after an attempted attack on the leader's vehicle, while protesters demanded the arrest of Imran.
